compute_l2_distance: compute the L2 distance between two 2D points using their x and y coordinates
calculate_relative_pose_change: calculate the relative pose change between two robot poses as delta x, y, and orientation
compute_new_pose: compute a new robot pose by applying a relative pose change to an existing pose
clamp_coordinates_to_bounds: clamp 2D coordinates to stay within the bounds of a given grid shape
review_pose_utils: review the pose utility functions for L2 distance, relative pose change, new pose, and coordinate thresholding
